content.text: I've finished scrolling all 15 screens, so here's how it went and then the form.

input.answer: I didn't pick one today. It's 143 tracks that all look alike and the page doesn't recommend any. If I had to, I'd go for an "עוקב מדד S&P500" track at a company I know, like מנורה מבטחים (0.52%) or אלטשולר שחם (0.54%), because the fees all look tiny and S&P is what my friends talk about.

stuck.where: Screen 2, the first rows of the table
stuck.why: Rows start straight under the column headers and I never saw which company they belong to, so the cheap S&P one at 0.56% with 13.7% has no name for me
Company after company with the same track names and fees between 0.5% and 0.7%. I couldn't tell them apart and got bored around מיטב / אלטשולר
Lots of S&P and stock tracks show 'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead of a number, so I can't compare them to the ones that show 13–14%
A whole company where every fee says 'עוד לא דווח' with an orange warning mark. That scared me off it

used: Big heading 'כל המסלולים בכל החברות' and the selected 'קופת גמל להשקעה 143' button
The 'עוקב מדד s&p 500' filter chip (I didn't tap it)
Fee 'ההחיסכון' percentages, e.g. 0.52% מנורה, 0.54% אלטשולר, 0.56% the first company
Return numbers like '3 שנים 13.7%' and '5 שנים 11.92%'
Company header rows: מור, אנליסט, מיטב, אלטשולר שחם, ילין לפידות, כלל, מנורה מבטחים, אינפיניטי, איילון
skimmed: The intro paragraph under the heading
The ring charts with מניות / מט"ח percentages
Most rows that aren't S&P or מניות
skipped: The yellow notice 'נתוני הרשות לא עודכנו מאז ספטמבר 2026'
The '123 מקורב / מחושב / הזנתה' legend line
The grey text under the chips and at the bottom of the table
The 'מה זה קופת גמל להשקעה' link
unsure_meaning: ההפקדות vs ההחיסכון: two fees, not sure which one I'd actually pay
חשיפה למניות ולמט"ח: rings with yellow and teal, I guessed teal is stocks and yellow is dollars
משולב סחיר / מניות סחיר: what does סחיר add?
'פחות מ־3 שנים' in the return column
not_found: Fees shown in shekels for my 30,000 ₪
How to actually open one, a first step
The name of the company for the first rows in the table (screen 2)

findings.what: 143 near-identical rows and no recommendation or shortlist. Too many options, so I'd do nothing
The first company's name isn't visible above its rows, so the cheapest-looking tracks have no name
Fees only as small percents (0.5–0.7%), nothing in shekels, so they all feel like nothing and I can't tell which one matters
Many S&P/stock tracks show 'פחות מ־3 שנים' instead of a return, so I can't compare them
findings.where: Return column, e.g. אלטשולר שחם S&P, מור

findings.what: Orange '!' and 'עוד לא דווח' all over one company look like warnings
findings.where: איילון, screens 14–15; also some rows of הלכה/חדש

findings.what: Two fee lines (ההחיסכון, ההפקדות) with no explanation next to them
Ring charts with two colours I had to guess, and odd numbers like 101%
No button or next step for opening the fund
